# Skroll

> Event Ticketing Platform & Business Technology Solutions — Sri Lanka

## Overview
Skroll is a Sri Lankan technology company providing two core product lines:
1. **Skroll Events**: An end-to-end B2B event ticketing platform built for organizers in Sri Lanka.
2. **Skroll Business Solutions**: A bespoke software engineering studio designing automated operational pipelines for enterprise clients.

## Skroll Events (Ticketing Platform)
- **Local & International Payments**: Seamless checkout in LKR and USD with leading Sri Lankan gateways (PayHere, commercial banks) and global card networks.
- **Automated Multi-Channel Ticket Delivery**: Sub-second dispatch of unique, fraud-resistant QR codes and branded PDF tickets via both Email and SMS.
- **High-Speed Gate Check-In**: Sub-second QR verification app that operates reliably even in low-connectivity venue environments.
- **Live Sales & Attendance Analytics**: Real-time dashboard tracking revenue velocity, gate check-in speed, and ticket tier breakdown.
- **White-Label Customization**: Custom event branding on ticket PDFs, checkout styling, and confirmation messages.

## Skroll Business Solutions (Software Engineering)
- **Custom Workflow Automation**: Eliminates manual spreadsheets, WhatsApp follow-ups, and reconciliation bottlenecks.
- **Engineering Rigor**: Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and resilient API architectures by engineers grounded in University of Moratuwa CSE standards.
- **Purpose-Built Systems**: Tailored specifically to team workflows and local operating realities with zero generic SaaS templates.
